_note: The scenery dimension table shared by the whole team (JSON can't have comments, so the notes go here). The labeling script, model training and api-service all read this one file. If you change the dimensions (add, remove, rename), bump schema_version by one; labels and models should both record which version they use. score_range is the range of the model's output scores; the team agreed on 0-1. description is sent to Gemini as is, so write it clearly in English. The M2 dimensions are placeholders; the final list is still up to the team.

water.description: Rivers, lakes, ponds or coastline visible from the path

tree_canopy.description: Trees lining or shading the path

open_field.description: Wide open grass or meadow with long views

hills.description: Hills or elevation changes giving views

sky_view.description: Open sky, not boxed in by tall buildings

cultural_street.description: Lively streets with shops, cafes and street life

landmark.description: Well-known landmarks or points of interest

traffic.description: Heavy car traffic near the path

crowds.description: Many pedestrians on or near the path
